name: io.github.orbiterdev-ai/mcp-server
title: Orbiter Dev
description: One-tap iOS & Android biometric sign-off before AI agents take real-world action.

environmentVariables.name: ORBITER_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Orbiter Dev API endpoint URL (default: https://api.orbiterdev.ai)

environmentVariables.name: ORBITER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional API token (auto-managed after mobile pairing via orbiter_auth)

environmentVariables.name: ORBITER_ENABLE_LEGACY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose legacy telemetry and memory MCP tools in addition to core approval tools
